name: Sound and Fury
body:
You can weave roaring exclamation of your rage into your bardic performances.

Prerequisite: Cha 13, Berserker’s Cry, bardic performance class ability, rage class ability, Linnorm Kings affinity.

Benefit: You may unleash a berserker’s cry as part of the action to start a bardic performance (instead of as a separate move action).

In addition, if you start a bardic performance with a berserker’s cry, you may start and maintain it while raging. The bardic performance must be based on Perform (oratory or sing).
